projects.title: Harry Potter Fan site
projects.description: Multi-page static web-site, with linked contact page and themed game.

projects.title: Follow the snitch
projects.description: Interactive Harry Potter theamed colour theory game with real-time scoring, sound effects, and rewarding user interface animations.

projects.title: Robofriends Directory
projects.description: Dynamic web application integrating external REST APIs to fetch, render, and filter profile cards in real time.

projects.title: Spring Boot RESTful Service
projects.description: Backend enterprise service architecture implementing layered MVC pattern, JPA/Hibernate persistence, and secure REST endpoints.

projects.title: Bubble Pop Arcade Game
projects.description: Retro-style 2D action arcade game built in Java. Players navigate an agile pea-shooter along the bottom axis to pop descending, splitting balloons before time elapses. Features precise collision detection, projectile physics, animated sprite states, and escalating difficulty levels.

projects.title: Classic Minesweeper
projects.description: Complete Java desktop implementation of the iconic logic puzzle game Minesweeper. Powered by recursive flood-fill algorithms for cascading empty tile discovery, dynamic mine generation guaranteeing safe initial clicks, flag placement toggles, and live move/time counters.

projects.title: Jeu de l'Oie (Game of the Goose)
projects.description: Faithful recreation of the classic French board game 'Jeu de l'Oie' featuring visual board progression paired with rich console diagnostic logs. Incorporates random dice roll simulation, multi-player turn management, and specialized trap squares (the well, labyrinth, prison, and death tile) using OOP design patterns.

projects.title: Dungeons & Dragons Console RPG
projects.description: Comprehensive turn-based text RPG engine ('Dundrag') in Java modeling core D&D gameplay mechanics. Leverages strict OOP inheritance and polymorphism for character classes, modular equipment, and enemy combatants (dragons, goblins, sorcerers), backed by a MySQL database via JDBC/DAO for persistent character saves and inventory stats.

projects.title: Decoupled Portfolio Website
projects.description: Modern responsive static web application with client-side component injection, dynamic JSON badge and ticker loaders, and dark mode.

projects.title: MJC Festi'Môm Ticketing Platform
projects.description: Full-stack event showcase and ticketing portal developed for the MJC Annemasse to manage their flagship October Festi'Mômes children's festival. Engineered with Node.js and Express using EJS server-rendered templates, backed by a PostgreSQL relational database managing live schedules, venue capacities, stage shows, workshops, and family bookings.

projects.title: Budget app
projects.description: App to set a monthly budget for a household, with dashboard, persistance with database.

projects.title: Swiss Cybersecurity Collaboration
projects.description: Active collaborator with Swiss Cybersecurity Geneva community, participating in threat modeling workshops and security awareness initiatives.

projects.title: Swiss Cybersecurity Interactive Quiz
projects.description: Interactive cybersecurity evaluation quiz built for Swiss Cybersecurity Geneva networking events and run locally in-browser. Built with vanilla HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript, it challenges attendees across diverse security domains—threat vectors, social engineering, password security, and incident response—with instant score calculation and explanations.

projects.title: Geneva Pathology Lab Biopsy Automation
projects.description: Automated clinical data processing application created for a pathology and histology laboratory in Geneva. Engineered using Microsoft Excel VBA and custom macro routines, the solution streamlines manual diagnostic data capture, tabulates patient biopsy metrics, auto-generates comparative trend graphs, and outputs standardized analytical summary texts.
